name: DuckDB CQRS Phase 2
description: Instrument write paths so source mutations create compact durable deltas, import writers pre-extract hot fields, and reviewer actions have a small immediate feedback path before projections catch up.

userStories.title: Add source high-water and idempotency helpers
userStories.description: As a developer, I want shared high-water and idempotency helpers so every review-serving delta writer allocates source marks consistently and deduplicates retries safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Add shared Phase 2 helpers in `src/server/reviewServing/reviewServingDeltaLedger.ts` or a sibling used only by ledger/reconciliation code.
Allocate `source_high_water_mark` by incrementing `app.review_delta_reconciliation_cursor.source_high_water_mark` inside the same DuckDB transaction as the source write and delta or outbox append.
Source high-water allocation is monotonic per `source_partition`.
Deterministic idempotency keys are derived from stable source mutation identity and compact typed keys, not random IDs, attempt IDs, process-time timestamps, or allocated high-water marks.
Duplicate append attempts with the same idempotency key are no-ops that return the existing delta or outbox identity and do not allocate a second effective mutation.
No serving projections are populated, no snapshots are promoted, no product routes are switched, and no project-scale selected-import fanout is introduced.
bun test src/server/reviewServing passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Add review-serving delta ledger append APIs
userStories.description: As a developer, I want typed delta append APIs so import and review source mutations can persist compact durable delta rows with the Phase 1 common envelope.
acceptanceCriteria: Create append APIs for `app.import_run_article_delta` and `app.review_change_delta` using change kinds from the invalidation registry.

Every appended delta includes the common envelope fields: `delta_id`, `change_kind`, `source_table`, `source_row_id`, `source_operation`, `source_partition`, `source_high_water_mark`, `source_updated_at`, `idempotency_key`, `payload_version`, typed key columns, optional `payload_json`, `created_at`, and `reconciled_at`.
Append APIs validate emitted change kinds against the invalidation registry and reject unknown kinds.
Delete and removal deltas support tombstone semantics for replay after source deletes/removals.
Import delta ledger tests cover deterministic idempotency keys, tombstones, common envelope fields, and no affected-project fanout.
No serving projections are populated, no snapshots are promoted, no product routes are switched, and no project-scale selected-import fanout is introduced.
bun test src/server/reviewServing passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Add delta outbox reconciliation foundation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want durable outbox reconciliation for write paths that cannot append deltas transactionally so dependent watermarks cannot advance past missing or malformed deltas.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/server/reviewServing/reviewServingDeltaReconciliation.ts` for converting, retrying, and quarantining `app.review_source_change_outbox` rows.
Write paths that cannot append a delta in the source transaction can create an outbox row with the allocated high-water mark before returning success.
Reconciliation prevents dependent watermark advancement while unreconciled source high-water marks are pending, retryable, or quarantined without an explicit terminal operator decision.
Tests prove source writes and delta/outbox writes are atomic or reconciled before watermarks advance.
Tests prove malformed outbox rows are retried or quarantined and do not silently become successful product paths.
No serving projections are populated, no snapshots are promoted, no product routes are switched, and no project-scale selected-import fanout is introduced.
bun test src/server/reviewServing passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Add import hot-field extraction service
userStories.description: As a developer, I want import writers to pre-extract compact hot fields so projectors can avoid parsing raw JSON for selected import, display, filters, postings, and contribution keys.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/server/reviewServing/reviewImportHotFieldService.ts` for deriving compact typed rows for `app.review_import_article_hot_field`.
Extract only compact fields needed by selected-import ranking, display, filters, postings, and contribution keys.
Raw source JSON, large metadata, and audit payloads remain in existing source/audit tables and are not copied into hot fields.
Missing source hot fields are stored as typed null/unavailable values rather than requiring projectors or foreground reads to parse raw JSON.
Tests prove projectors do not need raw JSON for selected-import ranking, display, filters, postings, or contribution keys.
No serving projections are populated, no snapshots are promoted, no product routes are switched, and no project-scale selected-import fanout is introduced.

acceptanceCriteria: Instrument canonical article writes in `articleImportStoreService.ts` and `articleCanonicalMatcher.ts` for display, search text, and judgment-input content changes.

Tests prove display, search, and judgment-input-content identities advance independently.

userStories.title: Instrument project-scope membership deltas
